title: How to Create a Project
summary: Create a new project entry in the EPIC Database, from required fields through confirmation.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: This guide shows how to create a new project in the EPIC Database.

steps.title: Initiate project creation
steps.body: After logging in, click Create Project to begin a new project entry.

steps.title: Access project entry
steps.body: The progress bar tracks required fields across each project stage: Entry, Active, and Closeout.

steps.title: Complete required fields
steps.body: To create a project, all Entry stage requirements must be completed before submission.

steps.title: Enter the project name
steps.body: Type the name of the project in the Project Name field.

steps.title: Enter the project number
steps.body: The organization prefix is added automatically. The system also checks whether the project number is already in use.

steps.title: Upload the main project image
steps.body: Upload the main project image. This appears as the project's primary image in the project list.

steps.title: Add gallery images
steps.body: You can upload up to 6 additional images to create a project gallery slideshow on the project page.

steps.title: Review the final entry
steps.body: Before submitting, make sure all Entry requirements are completed. Missing required fields will prevent the project from being created until they are filled in.

steps.title: Finalize project creation
steps.body: Click Create Project to submit the new project.

steps.title: Confirm project creation
steps.body: The system may take a few seconds to create the project.

steps.title: View the confirmation
steps.body: Once the project is created, you'll see a confirmation message and be redirected to the project page.

steps.title: Browse the gallery
steps.body: Use the Next arrow to browse through the project gallery.

steps.title: Review project details
steps.body: Use the project tabs to view the information entered during creation, including goals, funding, contacts, images, and other project details.

steps.title: You're done
steps.body: Your project has been created successfully. For questions or issues, reach out to the support team.
